semiconductor_relevance: High — Huoquan Machine Tools specializes in semiconductor processing equipment, particularly for silicon carbide components.
summary: Huoquan Machine Tools (Nanjing) Co., Ltd. provides comprehensive turnkey projects for the semiconductor industry, focusing on silicon carbide component processing equipment. Their offerings include equipment, tools, and maintenance services tailored for various semiconductor manufacturing processes.

regional_presence.China: Huoquan Nanjing operates in Jiangsu Province with multiple branch offices in Suzhou, Wuxi, and Xuzhou.
